title: Devilish or Delightful? Krampus Is Banned From a Christmas Parade.
summary_full: After an appearance last year, a float depicting Krampus, St. Nicholas’s evil accomplice, will not be allowed in an Ontario town’s Santa Claus parade on Saturday.
